metadata.dcterms:title: A Formula for the Colored Jones Polynomial of 2-Bridge Knots
metadata.dcterms:creator: Takata, Toshie
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We derive a formula for the colored Jones polynomial of 2-bridge knots. For a twist knot, a more explicit formula is given and it leads to a relation between the degree of the colored Jones polynomial and the crossing number.
